description: Bring classic charm to your nursery with the Newport Crib, a timeless 4-in-1 convertible design crafted from solid hardwood. The warm Brown Maple finish and clean lines create a warm, inviting centerpiece for your baby's room. This crib converts effortlessly from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size bed, growing with your child from newborn through adolescence. Three adjustable mattress positions let you customize the height as your little one grows, keeping safety front of mind. Finished with non-toxic, baby-safe materials that meet or exceed all CPSC and ASTM safety standards. Coordinates beautifully with the full Newport collection of dressers, chests, and nightstands to create a complete nursery you'll treasure.
